item.title: Ki Editor: Treat Code Like LEGO Blocks
item.description: Ki Editor isn't for writing text—it's for building with blocks. It operates directly on your code's syntax tree (AST), letting your cursor jump between expressions, functions, and entire code blocks. Multi-cursor editing relies on syntax structure, not visual alignment. After using it for a week, I never want to go back to plain text editors.

item.title: Claude Code Re-Explores Your Codebase Every Session? CodeGraph Cuts That Cost by 30%
item.description: Claude Code burns through massive tokens re-exploring your codebase every new session. CodeGraph pre-builds a code knowledge graph that cuts exploration overhead by 30%. Stop paying the 'navigation tax' on repeat.

item.title: Deep Dive into Claude Code Subagents: Building Your AI Team Like LEGO Blocks
item.description: Master Claude Code CLI's subagent mechanism and learn how to manage your AI assistants like building a team, with each agent specializing in their own domain to boost development efficiency.
